goal:
A public 'where the money goes' panel. Spec: docs/payments/2026-11-01-paid-board-revision-spec.md §R1, §R2.

SCOPE
- Read get_revenue_state: NEAR waiting, mPOO waiting, staker reserve, burned so far (from events or a view), next distribution time, the team, buyback and staking accounts with explorer links.
- The split in one line: NEAR 10% team / 90% buys mPOO; mPOO 10% team / 70% TOILET stakers / 20% burned.
- A 'Distribute now' button when the interval has passed (anyone can call it).
- Built to the standard of docs/visual-concepts/palette-16-proposal.html: explanations next to the numbers, real data, phone and desktop.

ACCEPTANCE
- Tests for formatting yocto amounts, the countdown, and the button's enabled state.
- Screenshots at 390 px and desktop.

BEFORE YOU START
Read AGENT.md, docs/learning/traps.md and the spec section named above. Contract changes were approved by the owner on 1 Nov for this revision only, on testnet. Do not deploy to mainnet.

DONE MEANS
AGENT.md's definition of done: tests named that fail before and pass after, cargo test / npm test / npm run build as relevant, a '## Learned' line in the PR, and the backlog row's new status written in the PR description (the merger updates docs/backlog.md on main; see AGENT.md).
